::: {.bnr-manual-flag .bnr-manual-flag--technical}
Technical Manual
:::

## What this step does

Mortality Step 6 checks `approval.yml`, `public_manifest.csv` and every approved file before copying the exact ten authorised files across the private/public boundary.

It creates the data-release ZIP and catalogue record, then refreshes the website copy from the official public analytical package. It does not rebuild the central Downloads catalogue, render Quarto or deploy the website.

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Procedure at a glance"}
1. Run Step 6 for the approved year and month.
2. Confirm `PUBLISHED` and `Verification: PASSED`.
3. Check the official public analytical package and website copy.
4. Rebuild the Downloads catalogue, render the site locally and review it.
5. Deploy the approved website changes through GitHub.
:::

## Before you start

- Complete Step 5 successfully for the same data release.
- Confirm `approval.yml` says `promotion_status: pending_step_6`.
- Do not edit `approval.yml`, `public_manifest.csv` or any of the ten authorised files.
- Leave replacement unticked unless a deliberate republication has been authorised.

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Input files"}

Step 6 reads `$BNR_STAGING/mortality/burden/mort_YYYY_MM/public_ready/`.

| File | What Step 6 uses or checks |
|---|---|
| `approval.yml` | Private approval record: identity, authorised approver, five human confirmations and the approved file-list checksum. |
| `public_manifest.csv` | Private generated list of the exact ten files authorised for publication, with sizes and checksums. |
| `datasets/mort_burden_metrics_mort_YYYY_MM.dta` | Approved data-release mortality measures in Stata format. |
| `datasets/mort_burden_metrics_mort_YYYY_MM.csv` | Approved CSV copy of the data-release measures. |
| `datasets/mort_burden_metrics_current.dta` | Approved stable-name measures in Stata format. |
| `datasets/mort_burden_metrics_current.csv` | Approved stable-name CSV copy. |
| `datasets/mort_monthly_reference_2015_2019.dta` | Approved fixed monthly reference in Stata format. |
| `datasets/mort_monthly_reference_2015_2019.csv` | Approved CSV copy of the fixed monthly reference. |
| `metadata/mort_burden_metrics_mort_YYYY_MM.yml` | Approved description of the data-release measures. |
| `metadata/mort_burden_metrics_current.yml` | Approved description of the stable-name measures. |
| `metadata/mort_burden_package.yml` | Approved description of the complete data package. |
| `metadata/mort_monthly_reference_2015_2019.yml` | Approved description of the fixed monthly reference. |

Only the ten files listed in `public_manifest.csv` may cross the private/public boundary. The approval record, file list and private review evidence remain private.

:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Code files"}

| File | How it is used |
|---|---|
| `scripts/stata/mortality/bnr_mort_s6_publish.do` | Main Step 6 controller; verifies and publishes the approved files. |
| `scripts/stata/dialogs/bnr_mort_s6_publish.dlg` | Stata dialog for the year, month and republication choice. |
| `scripts/stata/menu/bnr_menu.do` | Adds Step 6 to the BNR Stata menu. |
| `site/scripts/build_download_catalogue.py` | Run after Step 6 to rebuild the website’s central Downloads catalogue. |

:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Output files"}

The official public analytical folder is `$BNR_PUBLIC/metrics/mortality/burden/`. The matching public website copy is `$BNR_REPO/site/downloads/files/metrics/mortality/burden/`.

| File | What Step 6 creates or refreshes |
|---|---|
| `datasets/mort_burden_metrics_mort_YYYY_MM.dta` | Official public data-release measures in Stata format. |
| `datasets/mort_burden_metrics_mort_YYYY_MM.csv` | Official public CSV copy of the data-release measures. |
| `datasets/mort_burden_metrics_current.dta` | Official public stable-name measures in Stata format. |
| `datasets/mort_burden_metrics_current.csv` | Official public stable-name CSV used by the dashboard. |
| `datasets/mort_monthly_reference_2015_2019.dta` | Official public fixed monthly reference in Stata format. |
| `datasets/mort_monthly_reference_2015_2019.csv` | Official public fixed-reference CSV used by the dashboard. |
| `metadata/mort_burden_metrics_mort_YYYY_MM.yml` | Public description of the data-release measures. |
| `metadata/mort_burden_metrics_current.yml` | Public description of the stable-name measures. |
| `metadata/mort_burden_package.yml` | Public description of the complete data package. |
| `metadata/mort_monthly_reference_2015_2019.yml` | Public description of the fixed monthly reference. |
| `bnr_mort_burden_mort_YYYY_MM.zip` | Download package containing the same ten approved files. |
| `catalogue/mort_YYYY_MM.yml` | Data-release record read by the central Downloads catalogue builder. |
| `$BNR_PRIVATE_LOGS/bnr_mort_s6_publish_mort_YYYY_MM.log` | Private publication log. |

The stable dashboard data file is `datasets/mort_burden_metrics_current.csv`. The fixed reference is `datasets/mort_monthly_reference_2015_2019.csv`.

:::

## Publish the approved files

1. In Stata, choose **User > BNR > Update CVD mortality dashboard > Step 6: Publish approved mortality outputs**.
2. Enter the approved year and month, leave republication/replacement unticked for a first publication, and select **Publish Step 6**.
3. Alternatively, enter the complete routine command in the **Stata command window**:

   ```stata
   do "$BNR_STATA/mortality/bnr_mort_s6_publish.do" 2026 7
   ```

4. For a deliberate authorised republication, enter the complete replacement command:

   ```stata
   do "$BNR_STATA/mortality/bnr_mort_s6_publish.do" 2026 7 replace
   ```

5. In `MORTALITY STEP 6: OPERATIONAL RUN SUMMARY`, confirm `Run status: PUBLISHED` and `Verification: PASSED`.
6. Check the official public analytical folder contains the ten approved files, ZIP and `catalogue/mort_YYYY_MM.yml`.
7. Check the website folder contains matching copies.
8. Open the ZIP and confirm it contains the ten approved dataset and metadata files.
9. Confirm `approval.yml`, `public_manifest.csv` and all private review files are absent from both public locations.

## Update and check the website

Step 6 completes analytical publication only. It does not make the website change live.

1. In VS Code, open **Terminal > New Terminal**. Confirm the prompt is a PowerShell terminal at the repository root.
2. Run the Downloads catalogue builder:

   ```powershell
   python site/scripts/build_download_catalogue.py
   ```

3. Confirm the command completes without an error and review the resulting Git changes.
4. Use the normal local Quarto route to inspect the mortality dashboard and Downloads page, then complete a full local render.
5. Commit the approved changes on the development branch, push that branch and deploy through the normal GitHub pull-request process.

A successful Step 6 publication does not mean the website has been deployed. A successful local render also does not make the change live.

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="If Step 6 does not complete"}

| Situation | Action |
|---|---|
| Approval, file-list or checksum validation fails | Return to Step 5 or the earliest changed workflow step. Do not alter the private control files. |
| Publication stops after some copies were made | Inspect both the official public folder and website copy before rerunning. Use `replace` only after deliberate republication is authorised. |
| The catalogue or website check fails after `PUBLISHED` | Keep the analytical publication intact. Correct the website-side problem, rerun the catalogue builder or render, and do not recalculate the mortality data package. |

Never repair a partial publication by hand-copying individual files. For other problems, see [Troubleshoot the workflow](../../maintenance/troubleshooting.qmd).

:::
